metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the self-contained Node.js CLI at [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js). It supports all four actions, validates MARC 21 fields and UTF-8 ISO 2709 payloads, and returns structured errors.

Verified syntax, 16 CLI cases covering round trips and malformed records, and a run using only files copied from `output/`.
